criteria.rationale: The premise, that these four sources belong to no spec, was checked against each one: docs, mechanisms and releases have no spec field, and a finding's scope may be done. The release rule rests on a measurement: 21 unverified records on pose-dist, all but one superseded.

Additive to obligation schema v1: a new origin kind and two node kinds; existing obligation ids keep their sources, so none moves. All new effects are advisory, so no phase that was clear becomes blocked; a fresh install still reads complete.
The ADR is the decision record of R1.

mappings.rationale: The ADR records the project-level origin R1 introduces.

criteria.rationale: POSE.md, the pt-BR manual and both scaffold copies describe the four sources and drop the not_used wording; the ADR records the contract change and the schema documents the new kinds.

Attention on pose-dist reads complete and shows the one release actually in flight; Harne8 shows its four open docs review marks. Each producer reads files the engine already parses. Full native run at the sealed head with the candidate CLI built from it: every step passes, including attention-sources-integration.

One producer file, the registration in the projection, the two contract enums, schema, manuals, the ADR, tests, a matrix check and the spawned disposition. Reviewed in the same session that implemented it, with no separate reviewer execution: declared, not independent.

Read-only: the producers read the docs review log, the capability assessment, release records and legacy review records under the repository and write nothing; owners come from the project's own manifests.

One origin kind and two node kinds is the smallest contract change that lets the four sources be owed without inventing a spec owner; the release rule keeps history out instead of adding a filter flag.
